newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: P&O Nedlloyd says appoints new Sri Lanka agent.
newsitem.headline: P&O Nedlloyd says appoints new Sri Lanka agent.

text.p: P&O Nedlloyd, the new container shipping line created by the merger of two big European shipping firms, has appointed Sri Lanka's P&O Nedlloyd Keells as their agents, the local firm said on Wednesday.
P&O Nedlloyd Keells is a joint venture between P&O Nedlloyd and John Keells Holdings, a company statement said.
P&O Nedlloyd commands a fleet of 112 ships with nine new vessels on order.
P&O Nedlloyd was formed in January by the merger of P&O Containers, a unit of Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co. (P&O) and Nedlloyd Lines.
